rows.episode_title: Yo Gabba Gabba Live! - There's a Party in my City!
rows.synopsis: Join D.J. Lance Rock, Brobee, Toodee, Foofa, Plex, Muno and all of our favorite Yo Gabba Gabba! friends for their first-ever live concert. Get up on your feet to sing and dance along to Gabba favorites, including: There's a Party in My Tummy, Name Game and Get The Sillies Out. This concert is packed with special guests including Biz Markie, the incomparable Leslie Hall & DO IT teaching a Dancey Dance, Super Music Friends Show guest The Aquabats performs everyone's favorite, Pool Party.
rows.situation: Joining a big live concert and getting up to sing and dance with the whole crowd.
rows.notes: Synopsis-only (no script source for Season 0). Concert special: the fun is the show itself, so no coping moment is shown. Topic: the story is a live sing-and-dance concert.
